implementation.procedure: Replay actual source-view CLI against exact current Python source and host targets.
implementation.acceptance: Focused only when smaller; requested whole declaration and static local closure plus all other nondefinition bytes retained.

reference_boundary.procedure: Check source bytes/line boundaries, declaration effects, dynamics/ambiguity/stale/root/budget and seven tests.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Recognized dynamic namespace and unsupported syntax keep full; no rewrite/truncation/claim of external or whole-program completeness.

data_integrity.procedure: Check all fixed pre-dispatch sources/plan/schema/views/profiles/input SHA and exactly2 native successful fresh no-tool turns.
data_integrity.acceptance: Actual final native input+output, reasoning included; cache not subtracted, no retries/old bills.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Independently execute fixed current check_scoped_catalog on three frozen small cases, compare exact model answers and totals.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Both exact function oracle answers; candidate total lower; first<=25000/pair<=50000.

measurement_validity.procedure: Check identical model/high/policy/workspace/config/schema/question/tools and every actual non-task instruction byte.
measurement_validity.acceptance: Only declared full-versus-symbol source display differs; current source SHA and all requested function/nondefinition bytes exact.

reproducibility.procedure: Separate host replays actual CLI/native originals/source mapping/function oracle and7 tests without inference.
reproducibility.acceptance: Fixed different-owned verify_experiment_result gates main; one short local function task only.

scope: one short real Python function interpretation task on three fixed cases; exact local symbol source view, not repository localization/whole-program/long-context/cash
